camel_example: aliyun ndr ListEntities --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy LastSeenTime --PageSize 10 --SortOrder desc --Page 1 --Lang zh --RecommendStatus 1 --EntityType.1 1 --ExcludeCountry true --EntityKey '192.0.2.10' --EntityUuid 'f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291' --RecommendAction observe --IsExternal true --CountryCode.1 CN --IncidentUuid 'f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291' --HideBlocked true --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Performs a paging query on event-associated entities or global entities and returns entity properties, association statistics, and recommended action summaries
description_zh: 分页查询事件关联实体或全局实体，返回实体属性、关联统计和推荐处置摘要
kebab_example: aliyun ndr list-entities --page 1 --page-size 10 --incident-uuid f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291 --entity-uuid f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291 --entity-key 192.0.2.10 --entity-type 1 --is-external true --hide-blocked true --recommend-status 1 --recommend-action observe --order-by LastSeenTime --sort-order desc --lang zh --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEntities

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，默认 10，最多 100 条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security event. If this parameter is not specified, the global entity list is queried
parameters.help_zh: 安全事件 ID。不传时查询全局实体列表
parameters.name: incident_uuid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the entity, which can be obtained from ListEntities
parameters.help_zh: 实体 ID，可从 ListEntities 获取
parameters.name: entity_uuid

parameters.help_en: The business value of the entity, such as an IP address, a domain name, or a cloud instance ID. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 实体的业务值，例如 IP 地址、域名或云实例 ID，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: entity_key

parameters.help_en:
The list of entity types. Valid values:
1: IP address.
2: Cloud instance.
3: Host account.
4: Domain name.
5: Back-to-origin aggregation node of cloud services.
6: File.
If this parameter is not specified, type 5 is excluded by default
parameters.help_zh: 实体类型列表。1 表示 IP，2 表示云实例，3 表示主机账号，4 表示域名，5 表示云产品回源聚合节点，6 表示文件。不传时默认排除类型 5
parameters.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the entity is an external entity. Valid values:
true: queries only external entities.
false: queries only internal entities.
If this parameter is not specified, entities are not filtered by internal or external attributes
parameters.help_zh: 是否为外部实体。true 表示仅查询外部实体，false 表示仅查询内部实体；不传时不按内外部属性过滤
parameters.name: is_external

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to hide entities for which blocking has taken effect. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否隐藏已生效封禁的实体，默认 false
parameters.name: hide_blocked

parameters.help_en: Reserved parameter. This parameter is not used for query filtering. Do not specify this parameter. For the recommended action status, see Recommendation.Status
parameters.help_zh: 预留参数，当前不参与查询过滤，请勿设置。推荐处置状态请查看 Recommendation.Status
parameters.name: recommend_status

parameters.help_en:
The filter for recommended actions. Valid values:
block: blocks the entity.
observe: observes the entity.
allow: allows the entity.
none: no recommended action
parameters.help_zh: 推荐处置动作筛选。block 表示封禁，observe 表示观察，allow 表示放行，none 表示无建议动作
parameters.name: recommend_action

parameters.help_en:
The field used for sorting. Valid values:
LastSeenTime: the time when the entity was last discovered.
EntityKey: the entity value
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段。LastSeenTime 表示最近发现时点，EntityKey 表示实体值
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:
asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order.
Default value: desc for LastSeenTime, and asc for EntityKey
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向。asc 表示升序，desc 表示降序；LastSeenTime 默认 desc，EntityKey 默认 asc
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en:
The language of the returned content. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.
Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 返回内容的语言。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文，默认中文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The country codes for multi-select matching. You can specify up to 300 country codes, such as CN and US
parameters.help_zh: 国家代码，多选匹配，最多300项，如CN、US
parameters.name: country_code

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to exclude the selected countries. If this parameter is not specified, the selected countries are included. Unlocated entities are retained in exclusion mode. If CountryCode is empty, no filtering is performed
parameters.help_zh: 是否排除所选国家，未传为包含；未定位实体在排除模式下保留；CountryCode为空时不筛选
parameters.name: exclude_country

Indicates whether the entity is an external entity. Valid values:
true: The entity is an external entity.
false: The entity is an internal entity
IsExternal.description_zh: 是否为外部实体。true 表示外部实体，false 表示内部实体

LastSeenTime.description_en: The time when the entity was last discovered. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
LastSeenTime.description_zh: 实体最近发现时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
LastSeenTime.title_en: 实体最后发现时间，Unix毫秒
LastSeenTime.title_zh: 实体最后发现时间，Unix毫秒

Recommendation.description_en: The recommended action summary for the entity. The recommendation does not indicate that the action has been executed
Recommendation.description_zh: 实体的推荐处置摘要；建议不代表操作已执行

Action.description_en:
The recommended action. Valid values:
block: Block.
observe: Observe.
allow: Allow.
none: No recommended action
Action.description_zh: 推荐处置动作。block 表示封禁，observe 表示观察，allow 表示放行，none 表示无建议动作

Duration.description_en: The recommended blocking duration in seconds. A value of -1 indicates permanent blocking. This parameter is valid only when blocking is recommended
Duration.description_zh: 建议封禁时长，单位为秒；-1 表示永久。仅在建议封禁时有意义
Duration.title_en: 推荐封禁时长，单位秒，-1表示永久
Duration.title_zh: 推荐封禁时长，单位秒，-1表示永久

ReviewTime.description_en: The time of the last action review. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ReviewTime.description_zh: 最近一次处置研判时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

Status.description_en:
The generation status of the recommended action result. Valid values:
processing: Generating for the first time.
updating: Updating.
completed: Completed.
failed: Failed to generate for the first time.
update_failed: Failed to update.
When the value is updating or update_failed, the previous valid recommendation result can be retained
Status.description_zh: 推荐处置结果的生成状态。processing 表示首次生成中，updating 表示更新中，completed 表示完成，failed 表示首次生成失败，update_failed 表示更新失败。updating 和 update_failed 时可保留上一次有效推荐结果

Summary.example: 建议核对访问行为并持续观察。

RelateAlertCount.description_en: The number of raw alerts associated with the entity in the last 30 days. This is not limited to the current incident
RelateAlertCount.description_zh: 实体近 30 天关联的原始告警数量，不是仅当前事件内的数量

RelateIncidentCount.description_en: The number of security incidents associated with the entity in the last 30 days, counted by the most recent occurrence time of the incidents. This is not limited to the current incident
RelateIncidentCount.description_zh: 实体近 30 天关联的安全事件数量，按事件最近发生时点统计；不是仅当前事件内的数量

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number. Pages start from 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
PageSize.description_zh: 每页记录数，默认 10，最多 100 条

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的记录总数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails

Message.description_en: The description of the request result or the cause of the failure
Message.description_zh: 请求结果说明或失败原因

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to troubleshoot request issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查请求问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
